Name: Seasonal Farmer Portrait Template for non-modders
Author: Poltergeister
Description:
Works with 1.6!

I still get dms about a reddit post I made months ago asking me to share the seasonal farmer pack I use so I feel it's time to make this mod ^^'

This is meant to be used by non-modders and requires no editing of json files. There are more involved versions of this if you want to customize further, this is just one simple way of having seasonal farmer portraits.

Instructions:
1. download MistySpring's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url]. DO NOT download any of MistySpring's optional files[b].[/b] In the config file of MistySpring's mod or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], set the following configs:  
  "UseCustomPortrait": true,
  "UseCustomBackground": false
  "Show During Events": true

2. In my Seasonal Farmer Portrait template, simply switch out the blank images with the images you want to use.  Note: If there is a festival you don’t want to use a specific picture for and rather have the seasonal outfit show up, simply delete the blank image for that festival (example: you don’t want to have a new outfit for egg festival --> delete image assets/Festival/portrait_EggFestival.) Do not leave any of the images in assets/Festival blank or nothing will show up as your portrait during those specific events! Delete images instead.

If you would like to have your own farmer portraits in game, consider using the portrait creators made by me (Art) and Jaz (Code). They come in both
[url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]fem version [/url]and [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]masc version.[/url]

Downloads.Description: adds template for festivals and seasons. see mod description on instructions.
